## Accessibility

- **Accessible name:** the required `title` prop.
- **Keyboard:** The Callout title and description remain in reading order; keyboard focus reaches its primary action in platform order.
- **VoiceOver:** VoiceOver reads the Callout title and description before announcing its single primary action.
- **TalkBack:** TalkBack reads the Callout title and description before announcing its single primary action.
